headline: Executive order addresses diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) practices at companies that hold federal contracts.
what_it_does: This executive order, based on its title, sets out actions on what it calls discrimination tied to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) programs at federal contractors. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, or penalties are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that hold or seek federal government contracts
who_it_affects.how: They may face new rules or reviews about their DEI programs and hiring or workplace practices.
Workplace programs, training, or hiring practices at their employers may change.
They may be directed to enforce or check contractor compliance with the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 26, 2026; specific effective dates are not stated in the available information.
